long_biography.plain_text:
Miguel Galuccio brought former colleagues together to launch Vista Energy through a Mexican acquisition company financed by institutional investors. They used that capital to acquire oil and gas assets and develop production in Argentina's Vaca Muerta shale. Early acquisitions supplied producing fields while the group developed its shale assets. Galuccio remains Vista's chairman and chief executive.

His earlier work took him from YPF assignments in Argentina to operational posts abroad with Schlumberger. He led the latter's production-management business before returning to chair YPF in 2012, when the Argentine company faced a major investment challenge after nationalisation. At YPF he recruited experienced staff and advanced shale development. His experience there gave him direct familiarity with the formation that became Vista's production base.
